title: Repository activity — permission-holders by role
description: One row per repo: how many maintainers, committers and triage hold it, how many are active in the selected period, and activity split by role. Sorted by activity within that period. 'actions' = PRs + reviews + merges + issues + labels, summed.

columns.label: repo
columns.description: The repository name, as known to the governance config.

columns.label: maintainers
columns.description: Total maintainers with access to this repository, regardless of recent activity.

columns.label: committers
columns.description: Total committers with write access to this repository.

columns.label: triage
columns.description: Total users granted the triage role on this repository.

columns.label: active
columns.description: Permission-holders active in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: maint. actions
columns.description: Tracked actions (PRs, reviews, merges, issues, labels) by active maintainers in the selected period.

columns.label: comm. actions
columns.description: Tracked actions (PRs, reviews, merges, issues, labels) by active committers in the selected period.

columns.label: triage actions
columns.description: Tracked actions (PRs, reviews, merges, issues, labels) by active triage holders in the selected period.

columns.label: actions
columns.description: All tracked actions in this repository within the selected period, summed across roles.

columns.label: last active
columns.description: The most recent date any permission-holder had activity in this repository.
